'''Vrath Xizor''' (birth name unknown<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived">This is strongly implied in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''; Xizor claims to barely recall the name "his mother gave him" and the name Vrath Xizor is then referred to as the name given to him by his employers.</ref>) was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] as a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. By [[3653 BBY]], he had left the army and become a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked for a [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. In that year, he was hired to stop the [[Exchange]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] from delivering a shipment of [[engspice]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Hutts rivaled the Exchange's control over the engspice market, and intended to force the engspice users on Coruscant to buy from them instead. Xizor set out to locate Korr and found him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]], where Korr's daughter, [[Arra Yooms]], secretly lived. After spying on them in Karson's park, Xizor learned that Korr had a family, and realized that Korr would likely try to keep this a secret, as the Exchange could use his daughter for leverage. Xizor, along with his personal team, [[Skirmish in the Yinta Lake spaceport|attempted]] to stop Korr in a spaceport as Korr tried to leave the planet, but Korr, with the help of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]], defeated Xizor's team, killing multiple of them. Xizor anticipated Korr's next move and quickly traveled to Coruscant, where he attempted to stop Korr by warning the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;who had recently attacked and were [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] the planet&mdash;that Korr was going to attempt to run the blockade.

After attacking going aboard the ship and attacking the Sith guards simply to prove a point, Vrath was then escorted to the bridge, where he encountered the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. Vrath was intimidated by the Sith, and informed him that Korr and a Jedi would soon attempt to run the blockade. He witnessed Korr and Leneer's attempt to run the blockade in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Fatman]], ''but the vessel was shot down, although Korr and Leneer survived. Malgus then allowed Xizor to travel down to the planet's surface in a [[Dragonfly-class Imperial drop ship|''Dragonfly''-class drop ship]], [[Razor (Dragonfly-class)|''Razor'']], and he set down in [[Liston Spaceport]]. However, soon afterward, Korr attempted to commandeer the drop ship, and the two [[Skirmish in Liston Spaceport|engaged]] each other in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. They fought in a fierce battle, both men receiving heavy injuries due their military combat training, but Korr eventually subdued Xizor. Korr soon realize that Xizor knew about his daughter, and also realized that if he let the man leave, that he would be able to do nothing to stop Xizor from revealing the secret of his family to the Exchange. Although Xizor tried to convince Korr to release him, Korr reluctantly decided that Xizor could not be trusted, and pushed Xizor out the drop ship's [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.
